cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.
